name: novimode
description: A novi(1) save keeps the file's mode.  buf_save writes a temporary file with mkstemp -- created 0600 -- and renames it over the original, so the original's mode survives only if it is copied across: upstream stats the original and fchmods the temporary.  Workload: create /tmp/nvm, chmod it 755, open it in novi, type `a`, ^O, Enter, ^X; the same command line then lists and prints it.  `-rwxr-xr-x` can come only from the listing (the command echo spells the mode as 755), and `ahi` only from the saved file, so a save that did not happen fails too.  Without the fchmod the listing reads -rw-------, which is how this test was checked against itself.
command: echo hi >/tmp/nvm; chmod 755 /tmp/nvm; novi /tmp/nvm; ls -l /tmp/nvm; cat /tmp/nvm
